meta.title: Huang & Jia earth dam, dry
meta.notes: Homogeneous earth dam (c′ = 13.8 kPa, φ′ = 37°, γ = 18.2 kN/m³) before the reservoir is filled; circular search.

source.reference: Huang, M. & Jia, C.-Q. (2009). Strength reduction FEM in stability analysis of soil slopes subjected to transient unsaturated seepage. Computers and Geotechnics 36(1–2), 93–101.
source.derived_from: cSlope verification problem V063 (MIT License), https://github.com/ZilanCiftci/cslope
notes: Search limited to x = 101.7–185.6 (crest to the downstream berm), as in the source.
commercial program A reports the Spencer value only. The steady-seepage and drawdown stages need a seepage analysis.

Until 2026-10-25 the 2.43 check was labeled Spencer and attributed to the finite-element analysis; the paper states it is Bishop (LEM) and gives 2.50 for SSRFEM (docs/kallor/huang-jia-2009.md). cSlope Bishop 2.453, Spencer 2.451 on this search.
cSlope fija options.tolerance = 0.001 (tolerancia del solver) en sus checks; no se importa: ogs usa analysis.tolerance = 1e-05.

slope.direction fijado a left_to_right por el importador (DIRECTION_OVERRIDES): auto no puede resolver el sentido en esta presa simétrica con entry == exit; la orientación ltr reproduce el círculo crítico de cSlope (centro ≈ (154.2, 76.6), r ≈ 69.4).
